run_labgraph_module: run a Labgraph module using LocalRunner by passing a Module instance and optional RunnerOptions
setup_cthulhu_streams: set up Cthulhu producers and consumers for a Labgraph module's published and subscribed topic streams
create_local_runner: create a LocalRunner instance with a Module and optional RunnerOptions to execute foreground and background processing
run_setup_cleanup: run the setup and cleanup lifecycle methods on all descendant modules in the correct parent-first order
bootstrap_cpp_nodes: bootstrap C++ nodes in a Labgraph module by mapping topic paths to Cthulhu stream IDs
